summary: First full run. Backend: 25 pytest cases (auth, admin role checks, catalogue/search/filters, book detail for gutenberg/ia/openlibrary, reader, me-data, submissions approve/reject/duplicate, adult separation, admin CRUD/status/users/audit/stats) -> 24/25 pass; login throttling does NOT trigger 429 through the public URL (works on localhost) because the throttle key uses the ingress pod IP, which alternates. Frontend (390x844): home 3D shelf (prev/next/tap/read), sections, categories, footer, book detail (READ ONLINE / READ AT SOURCE), reader (next/prev/progress/settings sepia/size/scroll/reset/TOC/bookmark), search (fields, filter sheet, apply, list/grid/shelf, result tap), Mizo (collections, search, years, authors), auth signup, My Shelf tabs/profile edit, After Dark gate (disabled until tick, empty state), submit validation+success, admin login/dashboard/add book/save/publish via preview sheet/submission approve all work. One frontend bug: admin sub-screens opened by deep link or page reload send their first request before the admin token is restored, get a 401 and never retry, so the list stays empty. No deprecated Expo packages found.

critical.issue: Login throttling doesn't work in the deployed setup. auth.client_key() uses request.client.host, which is the ingress pod IP, and that changes between requests (logs show 10.219.0.6 and 10.30.130.133). Fails are spread across keys, so 6+ bad passwords via the public URL all return 401 and never 429. Verified that 429 does trigger on the 6th attempt against localhost:8001. Fix: key on the email alone, or on the first X-Forwarded-For hop + email (auth.py:100-101). _fails is also in-memory only, so it is lost on restart and not shared between workers.

minor.issue: Open Library language uses langs[0] from an unordered list, so Pride and Prejudice (openlibrary:OL66554W) shows 'German'. Prefer 'eng' or the original language when present (sources.py:153-158).
TOC titles use str.title(), giving 'Chapter Ii.', 'Chapter Iii.' etc., and Chapter I is missing (TOC starts at 'Chapter Ii.' page 22) (sources.py:318-324).

_check_publish only blocks a target status of 'published'. An editor can unpublish or archive a published book through PUT, and can edit a published book's content in place, while POST /status is admin-only. The rules are inconsistent (server.py:715-738).

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /admin/submissions or /admin/users by URL or after a page reload: useFocusEffect(load) runs before AdminProvider restores the admin token from storage. The request goes out with no token, gets a 401 (backend logs: GET /api/admin/submissions?status=pending 401, GET /api/admin/users?q= 401) and is never retried, so the list stays empty (0 rows) with no error. It works when reached from the dashboard modules. Fix: add admin/ready to load's deps or wait for ready (app/admin/submissions.tsx:29-33, app/admin/users.tsx:31; check books.tsx/audit.tsx too).

issues: Touch targets under 44px: featured-see-all 33x29, intl-chip-* 36px high, footer-* 40px high
Empty state repeats: a top 'No titles have been published here yet' card plus 'No titles yet.' under each of the 6 categories. Hide the empty categories when there are no books.
The eyebrow 'MIZO HERITAGE LIBRARY' repeats the big title 'MIZO HERITAGE LIBRARY' right below it

Once, after filter apply and view switching, the screen looked shifted left about 24px and the filter button was clipped at the right edge. Not reproduced on a fresh load (button right=366 of 390). Check for horizontal overflow in the header row / field-chip ScrollView.
Paragraph reflow merges Gutenberg front-matter contents lists into one block of text (Alice: all chapters on one run-on line)

action_items: Fix the login throttle key so it doesn't depend on the ingress pod IP (auth.py client_key: use email, or X-Forwarded-For first hop + email), and consider storing fails in Mongo
Admin sub-screens: reload data once the admin token is restored (deps on admin/ready) so deep links and reloads of /admin/submissions and /admin/users show data
Open Library language: choose 'eng'/original rather than langs[0]
Reader TOC: keep roman numerals uppercase (don't use str.title()) and detect Chapter I in gutenberg:1342
Make the editor permissions consistent (block unpublish/archive via PUT for editors, or document it)
Raise touch targets to at least 44px (intl chips, footer links, featured-see-all); remove the repeated After Dark empty messages and the repeated Mizo heading
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py throttle is an in-memory dict keyed by request.client.host, which is wrong behind a proxy and not durable
server.py is 860 lines; consider splitting it into routers (auth, catalogue, reader, me, admin)
POST /api/auth/forgot-password stores reset tokens even though no email provider exists; the 'not switched on' message is honest (email_configured=false confirmed)
Approving a submission whose duplicate_of is set still creates a second published book; the duplicate is only flagged in the UI

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; admin deep-link/reload empty-list bug)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ reader users (test_*@example.com; no user-delete API, so they remain; one test editor user was disabled). Created TEST_ books and submissions; every TEST_ book was deleted by id afterwards (admin books q=TEST_ returns []). Submission records (approved/rejected) remain because there is no delete endpoint. No seed or real data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env value> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_openbook_api.py (pytest-xdist runs in parallel by default, so each test cleans up its own data). frontend/.env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (no EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Admin login on the frontend is per-session; reach the admin sub-screens through the dashboard admin-module-* buttons. Admin edit form: hosted_text needs copyright public_domain/open_licence/permission_granted (edit-copyright-public_domain). Fresh DB has 0 local books.
rca_of_issue: Throttle: the backend log shows public-URL login attempts coming from 2 alternating ingress IPs, so key 'ip:email' never reaches 5 fails; on localhost a single IP gives 401x5 then 429. Admin empty lists: submissions.tsx load() useCallback deps=[status] only and is called in useFocusEffect on mount, while admin-context restores the token asynchronously (setAdminToken in useEffect). The first call has session.admin=null, so it gets a 401 and there is no re-run when admin becomes available.
